description: Returns the location of the specified substring in a string and is intended for languages that use the double-byte character set (DBCS) like Japanese, Chinese, Korean etc.

params.description: The text to find. The ? and * wildcard characters can be used. Use ~? and ~* to find the ? and * characters.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The text where to search for the specified text.
params.name: arg2

params.description: The character number in the search text, counting from the left, at which to start searching. If omitted, 1 is used.
params.name: arg3

signature: SEARCHB(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | string, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | string, arg3?: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
